## A platform built for the way real traders work.

TradeLocker brings you TradingView-grade charting, one-click execution, trailing stop-loss, and an integrated risk calculator, all in one clean, customizable interface designed for both novice and professional traders.


Seamless browser, desktop, and mobile, switch between devices without missing a beat. 500+ assets. Lightning-fast execution. Zero download friction.

Execution

## Straight-through pricing.  No dealing desk.

Every LivvFX trade is routed through an STP aggregator directly to top-tier liquidity providers. No dealing desk interference. No re-quotes. No conflict of interest.


**True A-book execution.** Your wins don't cost us a cent, we profit from volume, not from client losses.


You get the best available institutional price, executed at real-time speed, the way professional trading is supposed to work.
